context: Evaluates: Fully Specified Task Skips Framing

checklist.name: Known task recognised
checklist.description: **Known task recognised**: Agent identifies the request as fully specified and does not frame it.

checklist.name: Executes directly
checklist.description: **Executes directly**: Agent performs the rename (or states it is proceeding to) without routing through other skills.

checklist.name: No questions asked
checklist.description: **No questions asked**: Agent does not call AskUserQuestion or ask the triangulation tests.

checklist.name: No handoff produced
checklist.description: **No handoff produced**: Agent produces no handoff template and no routing line.
